common_scale.note: errors in units of M's level-1 SD (the wind-free set of this job)

energy_score.note: fair energy score (RMS norm, standardised level-1 coordinates) of residual-pool ensembles (m = 32 out-of-fold residual vectors, same draws for every predictor), mean over the 6 replicate truths; OES = (S_clim - S) / (S_clim - S_oracle) with S_clim the 'mean' predictor's ensemble and S_oracle the leave-one-out score of the replicate truths
